description: Search HQ-approved, opted-in Truth Packets available for commercial licensing. Requires a bearer API key (set the `apiKey` config value). An empty result means nothing currently matches the query, not that the location was checked and found clean.

offset.description: Zero-based offset into the matching result set.

radius.description: Search radius in meters, used with lat + lng.
